This test suite is a merger of tests from Fortran/test.f90 and
Python_Fortran/test.py upstream.  Test numbers x/y refer to the test numbers
in Fortran/test.f90 and Python_Fortran/test.py respectively.  Significant
changes:
- Used more precise expected results for Tests 10/4 and -/6.
- Used the same (quad precision) input for both double and quad precision
  implementations.
- Calculated error in quad precision for both double and quad precision
  implementations.
